mapping_note: RL-422 records that the pinned Lab candidate is incorrectly labeled §10.57.6 and bound to evokeCallback. The page-284 source layout places this completion rule under §10.58 Evoke Multiple Callbacks; this local contract preserves the candidate ID while mapping the tested public API behavior to canonical §10.58.
notes: The HLA_EVOKED public-API scenario sends three receive-order interactions over the first 70 ms of a 200 ms minimum / 750 ms maximum call. It verifies that all callbacks are drained and that the service completes near the minimum (within a 150 ms scheduling tolerance) rather than waiting out the longer maximum once no callback remains. This is bounded completion evidence, not exact scheduler accuracy, maximum-window behavior, HLA_IMMEDIATE behavior, Java parity, independent-provider interoperability, or RTI conformance.
